name: Undo Rejection from REJECTED_SUBMISSION restores the application and its flow continues
description:
Objective: Undo Rejection from REJECTED_SUBMISSION restores the application and its flow continues.
Preconditions: Kesef CRM QA at the configured origin; authorized test account; an existing application in the needed state discovered read-only, or an unsaved intake whose writes are blocked.
Steps:
1. Open the rejected application.
2. Undo Rejection with a reason.
3. Read the restored state and page.
Expected: Leaves the rejected state, rejection cleared, Reject Application available.
